message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Node CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: Git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Use Node.js 18.x
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 18.x
      - name: Prepare Environment
        run: |
          yarn install
          yarn build
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run typecheck and linter
        run: |
          yarn lint
        env:
          CI: true

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version: [14.x, 16.x, 18.x, 20.x, 22.x, 24.x, 26.x]

    steps:
      - name: Git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Prepare Environment
        run: |
          yarn install
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          yarn unit
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Send coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        if: matrix.node-version == '18.x'
      - name: Check docs generation
        if: matrix.node-version == '18.x'
        run: |
          yarn docs:test
        env:
          CI: true

  # validate-dependencies:
  #   name: Validate production dependencies
  #   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  #   continue-on-error: true
  #   timeout-minutes: 15

  #   steps:
  #     - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  #     - name: Use Node.js 18.x
  #       uses: actions/setup-node@v7
  #       with:
  #         node-version: 18.x
  #     - name: Prepare Environment
  #       run: |
  #         yarn install
  #       env:
  #         CI: true
  #     - name: Validate production dependencies
  #       run: |
  #         if ! git log --format=oneline -n 1 | grep -q "\[ignore-audit\]"; then
  #           yarn validate:dependencies
  #         else
  #           echo "Skipping audit"
  #         fi
  #       env:
  #         CI: true

  # validate-all-dependencies:
  #   name: Validate all dependencies
  #   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  #   continue-on-error: true
  #   timeout-minutes: 15

  #   steps:
  #     - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  #     - name: Use Node.js 18.x
  #       uses: actions/setup-node@v7
  #       with:
  #         node-version: 18.x
  #     - name: Prepare Environment
  #       run: |
  #         yarn install
  #       env:
  #         CI: true
  #     - name: Validate production dependencies
  #       run: |
  #         yarn validate:dependencies
  #       env:
  #         CI: true
  #     - name: Validate dev dependencies
  #       run: |
  #         yarn validate:dev-dependencies
  #       env:
  #         CI: true",
  "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout). The repository's recent CI history shows all workflow runs completing successfully in about 2-2.5 minutes, while both jobs currently carry a 15-minute timeout. Setting an explicit 5-minute custom timeout bounds runaway consumption with roughly 2x operational headroom over observed successful durations, matching the measured evidence where success was maintained and elapsed time decreased. This is coverage-preserving: no steps, matrix entries, or required checks are removed or cancelled, and no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
